headline: 2 Aera V2 contracts catalogued on Ethereum (1 vault, 1 asset registry); Base, Polygon and Arbitrum had zero cited addresses and no factory address was found.

findings.text: Only two web searches against etherscan.io returned Aera-tagged pages with a body. They surfaced an AeraVaultV2 at 0x7c84...47e4 (the page shows a net worth of about $9.2M) and an AeraVaultAssetRegistry-sourced contract at 0x77A3...06b9. Direct explorer searchHandler fetches were not attempted because the fetch budget ran out. Base, Polygon and Arbitrum were not searched.

The docs index (llms.txt) lists V2 archive contract-reference pages and a V3 'Cross-chain Deployments' page. It has no page named deployments or addresses. The V2 reference pages (AeraV2Factory, AeraVaultV2, AeraVaultAssetRegistry) document ABIs only and contain no deployed addresses. The cross-chain-deployments page was not fetched. protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc is left null.

The pinned Spearbit audit PDF on GitHub could not be fetched (tool budget exhausted). The aera.finance website links a V2 Spearbit report (Aug 2023) on its CDN, but that PDF was not opened either. No audit-scope addresses were extracted.
No GitHub repo walk was possible. protocol.github is empty and the aera-contracts-public repo root was rejected by the fetch allowlist. No broadcast or deployments artifacts were read.
Only Ethereum has any address. Base, Polygon and Arbitrum have zero addresses (see unknowns).
No factory address was discovered, so no children were enumerated. The docs say AeraV2Factory is one instance per chain and deploys the asset registry, hooks and vault atomically in that order.

Roles assigned: 0x7c84...47e4 is a vault (source file AeraVaultV2.sol). 0x77A3...06b9 is 'other (asset registry)' (source file AeraVaultAssetRegistry.sol). Bytecode was not read, so actor_class is 'unknown' for both.

Both admin_addresses entries trace to etherscan.io search-result bodies that include the address and contract source file names. Addresses seen only in a third-party CSV were not added and are listed under D8 in unknowns.

rationale.verdict: Walked the Aera website, the docs index, the V2 archive factory pages and two etherscan search results; 2 Ethereum addresses were catalogued and the rest of the surface remains undiscovered.

evidence.shows: Website: Aera treasury vault infrastructure built by Gauntlet. It links the developer docs at docs.aera.finance and a V2 Spearbit audit PDF (Aug 2023) on its CDN. It says audits were by Spearbit and OpenZeppelin. It says the vault owner establishes allowlists and guardians execute onchain actions.
Canonical docs site. Describes vaults with guardians constrained onchain by merkle-tree and hook-based calldata constraints, and mentions Aera V3 alongside V2.

Docs index. Lists a v2-archive contracts section (AeraV2Factory, AeraVaultModulesFactory, AeraVaultV2, AeraVaultAssetRegistry, AeraVaultHooks) and a V3 section (Cross-chain Deployments, Provisioner, Oracle Registry, etc.). It has no dedicated addresses or deployments page.
AeraV2Factory: onlyOwner create() deploys vault, asset registry and hooks. The docs say one instance is needed per chain. No address is listed.
Deployment goes through the AeraV2Factory in order: asset registry, hooks, vault. The Aera team recommends handling the deployment and handing ownership to the client. No addresses are listed.

Ethereum contract whose verified source is src/v2/AeraVaultV2.sol (Ownable2Step, Pausable, ReentrancyGuard imports). Contract name AeraVaultV2, BSL 1.1 licence. Page shows net worth of about $9.2M. Obtained as a search-grounding page body, not a direct fetch.

Ethereum contract whose verified source is src/v2/AeraVaultAssetRegistry.sol, with a Created event listing owner, vault, assets, numeraireToken, feeToken, wrappedNativeToken and sequencer. Obtained as a search-grounding page body, not a direct fetch.

unknowns: D1: Direct etherscan/basescan/polygonscan/arbiscan searchHandler fetches were not attempted because the fetch budget was exhausted. Only 2 web searches returned Aera-tagged etherscan pages. No Aera name-tag search was run on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum.
D1: No AeraV2Factory or AeraVaultModulesFactory address on any chain was found.

D1: AeraVaultHooks contract address(es) were not found. Owner, guardian, fee recipient and Safe addresses of the two Ethereum contracts were not read, because no read-API surfacer was pinned or reachable.

D2: No dedicated deployed-addresses page found in the docs index. The V3 'Cross-chain Deployments' page (https://docs.aera.finance/cross-chain-deployments.md) was not fetched. The app at app.gauntlet.xyz/vaults was not fetched.

D3: Spearbit audit PDF (https://github.com/aera-finance/aera-contracts-public/blob/main/v2/audits/spearbit/2023-09-22.pdf) fetch failed with 'no more web_fetch tool calls remaining'. The website-linked CDN Spearbit report was not opened. No in-scope addresses were extracted. The OpenZeppelin audit was not opened.
D4: protocol.github is empty. The aera-finance/aera-contracts-public repo root fetch was rejected by the allowlist. No commit SHA was pinned and no deployment artifacts were read.
D5: chain Base: zero addresses surfaced from the sources tried (website, docs index, 2 etherscan-focused searches).
D5: chain Polygon: zero addresses surfaced from the sources tried (website, docs index, 2 etherscan-focused searches).
D5: chain Arbitrum: zero addresses surfaced from the sources tried (website, docs index, 2 etherscan-focused searches).
D6: No factory address found, so no children were enumerated through the read API.

D8: A third-party CSV (https://web3-vulns.alecmaly.com/public/live_contracts.csv) labels three Ethereum addresses as AeraVaultV2: 0x3D6eEf6A92b15361697698695334E98C5db91D6b, 0x9ecf0d8dcc0076dd153749bece0762acae1c9049 and 0x744BfF6cA503955d87Fa6a90b866d8f952805C43. They are snippet-only, from a source outside the allowed classes, and were not verified on an explorer or through the read API. They are candidates for the next run.

D8: The Ethereum addresses 0x7c84...47e4 and 0x77A3...06b9 were seen only through search-result page bodies, not direct fetches or the read API. Their live owner, guardian and state are unread. Per-protocol check against the 'on-chain' rule: no /api/contract/read call was made, so grading_basis is 'mixed'.
D7: Whether each of the two catalogued addresses is a vault for the Aera V2 product or a different vault version was not confirmed beyond contract name and source path.
D3-offchain: The V2 audit report could not be read, so audit scope and findings are unverified. Audit entry in protocol_metadata is taken from the website link and file name only.

protocol_metadata.about: Aera lets DAOs and other treasury owners deploy onchain vaults that hold ERC20 and ERC4626 assets. One or more guardians execute strategies, and each action is checked against owner-configured constraints (asset registry, hooks allowlists and, in V3, merkle-tree calldata constraints). In V2 a factory deploys the vault, asset registry and hooks together, and the vault owner keeps control of funds.
